summary: 29-year-old backcountry skier struck a rock beneath the snow at the Anchor Mine above CR 129J west of Nederland, injuring his knee and unable to exit; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group provided first aid, litter-packaged him, conducted a technical evacuation, transferred him to a snow-tracked UTV and drove him out; evaluated by Nederland Fire, transported by family in a private vehicle
location: Anchor Mine, above County Road 129J, west of Nederland
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; American Medical Response; Nederland Fire Protection District
notes: Incident date 2021-01-10 (Sunday per Mountain-Ear story, parent-opened; originally published in the Jan 14, 2021 edition). BCSO case 21-192. Mined from the Mountain-Ear 2021-window angle, run 730 chunk B.
